summary: Prudential plc filed a Form 6-K reporting a routine PDMR share acquisition. Director Claudia Suessmuth-Dyckerhoff acquired 4,000 ordinary shares at GBP 10.9675 on 30 April 2026 via the London Stock Exchange. This is a standard insiders' dealings notification, not a corporate event. No board recommendation, advisors, or structural changes are involved. This is a routine disclosure under the Market Abuse Regulation, not a special situation.
